name: zdeclient_get_feature_grid_cell
description: zDEClient::GetFeatureGridCell returns a camera-owned feature grid cell by column and row, or null when camera class data is absent.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zDEClient initialization/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x458ac0 validates null return when g_zDEClient_CameraNodeClassData is null, then area lookup through featureGridRows[gridRow] plus gridCol * sizeof(zDEClient_FeatureGridCell).
The native zDEClient feature leaf smoke verifies the null path and that grid column 1, row 1 returns the expected feature grid cell.
